variables.input:
metrics
| filter metric.key == "custom.proxmox.cluster.nodes.total"
| filter isNotNull(cluster_name)
| fields cluster_name
| dedup cluster_name

metrics
| filter metric.key == "custom.proxmox.node.cpu.usage"
| filter isNotNull(node_name)
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| fields node_name
| dedup node_name

metrics
| filter metric.key == "custom.proxmox.vm.status"
| filter isNotNull(vm_name)
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| fields vm_name
| dedup vm_name

metrics
| filter metric.key == "custom.proxmox.lxc.status"
| filter isNotNull(lxc_name)
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| fields lxc_name
| dedup lxc_name

tile_vm_status.title: VM Status (1=running)
tile_vm_status.query:
timeseries min(`custom.proxmox.vm.status`), by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name

tile_vm_uptime.title: VM Uptime (seconds)
tile_vm_uptime.query:
timeseries max(`custom.proxmox.vm.uptime`), by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name

tile_vm_vcpus.title: VM vCPUs
tile_vm_vcpus.query:
timeseries avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.cpu.count`), by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name

tile_vm_snapshots.title: VM Snapshots
tile_vm_snapshots.query:
timeseries max(`custom.proxmox.vm.snapshot.count`), by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name

tile_vm_cpu.title: VM CPU Usage (%)
tile_vm_cpu.query:
timeseries avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.cpu.usage`), by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name

tile_vm_memory.title: VM Memory (Used / Total)

tile_vm_balloon.title: VM Balloon Memory (Current / Target)

tile_vm_disk_io.title: VM Disk Read / Write

tile_vm_network.title: VM Network In / Out

hdr_agent.content:
---
## 🔬 VM Guest Agent — $vm_name
*Requires `qemu-guest-agent` installed inside the VM.*

tile_agent_disk_table.title: In-Guest Filesystems
tile_agent_disk_table.query:
timeseries {
  used  = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.disk.used`),
  total = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.disk.total`)
}, by: {vm_name, mountpoint, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name
| fields mountpoint,
         used_bytes      = arrayLast(used),
         total_bytes     = arrayLast(total),
         used_pct        = (arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(total)) * 100

tile_agent_disk_chart.title: In-Guest Filesystem Usage Over Time

tile_agent_net_bytes.title: In-Guest NIC RX / TX Bytes

tile_agent_net_errors.title: In-Guest NIC Errors / Dropped

tile_agent_net_table.title: In-Guest NIC Snapshot
tile_agent_net_table.query:
timeseries {
  rx       = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.net.rx_bytes`),
  tx       = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.net.tx_bytes`),
  rx_err   = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.net.rx_errors`),
  tx_err   = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.net.tx_errors`),
  rx_drop  = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.net.rx_dropped`),
  tx_drop  = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.net.tx_dropped`)
}, by: {vm_name, iface, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter node_name == $node_name
| filter vm_name == $vm_name
| fields iface,
         rx_bytes   = arrayLast(rx),
         tx_bytes   = arrayLast(tx),
         rx_errors  = arrayLast(rx_err),
         tx_errors  = arrayLast(tx_err),
         rx_dropped = arrayLast(rx_drop),
         tx_dropped = arrayLast(tx_drop)
